title: Magnitude characterization of C4V long-horizon sign mismatches

V04.interpretation: Known one-step early reversal remains a separate timing diagnostic.

scope.source: Immutable C4V R16 trajectory plus deterministic reexecution of the unchanged frozen C4V LARE members.

diagnostics_per_member_history: exact candidate and Reference reversal steps
Reference and candidate terminal bottom flux at first mismatch and at each candidate reversal
minimum, median, p95 and maximum absolute Reference flux over mismatch steps
minimum, median, p95 and maximum absolute candidate flux over mismatch steps
minimum, median, p95 and maximum absolute terminal-flux error over mismatch steps
percentile rank of absolute Reference flux at first mismatch within that history's complete 1024-step absolute Reference-flux distribution
percentile rank distribution of absolute Reference flux over all mismatch steps
day-1 terminal Reference and candidate flux
interpretation_rules: Do not define or fit a near-zero deadband.
Do not relabel a sign mismatch acceptable or unacceptable.
Use percentile ranks only as threshold-free context for where mismatch magnitudes sit inside the same Reference trajectory.
C4V decision and minimum persistent dimension R8 are immutable.
C4W cannot authorize closure retuning, a new switch/blend, application acceptance or production use.

decision_logic.C4W_SPURIOUS_REVERSAL_MAGNITUDE_CHARACTE: All hard gates pass and the exact C4V mismatch/reversal pattern is reproduced with magnitude/rank diagnostics.
decision_logic.C4W_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any immutable-authority or reproduction gate fails.

next_after_close: Stop at representation-transfer choice: independently preregister material/constitutive transfer or lower-boundary semantics transfer. Absolute GW application acceptance remains blocked on external H_app/A_temporal provenance.
